## Fonts and icons

- **Icons:** [Lucide](https://lucide.dev/) (`lucide-react`, ISC). Brand marks, where shown, come from [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org/) (CC0-1.0); the trademarks belong to their owners.
- **Fonts:** the app uses the operating system's fonts.

## Services (web app only)

The web app at ytgenerator.stream is delivered by Cloudflare. These are services, not bundled code; the [Privacy Policy](PRIVACY.md) explains what each processes.

| Service | Purpose | Terms |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cloudflare Workers | Hosting and delivery | <https://www.cloudflare.com/terms/> |
| Cloudflare Turnstile | Bot check before entering | <https://www.cloudflare.com/turnstile-privacy-policy/> |
| Cloudflare Web Analytics | Cookieless, aggregate visit statistics | <https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/> |

The desktop and Android apps use none of them.
